title: Arduino Day Philippines 2026 - Opening Ceremony
description: Join us for the grand opening of Arduino Day Philippines 2026! Experience exciting announcements, keynote speeches, and a glimpse into the world of Arduino and IoT.
speaker: Dr. Maria Santos

title: Getting Started with Arduino - Workshop for Beginners
description: Learn the fundamentals of Arduino programming and electronics. Perfect for beginners looking to start their journey in physical computing and IoT.
speaker: Engr. Juan Dela Cruz

title: IoT and Smart Home Automation
description: Discover how to build your own smart home system using Arduino and ESP32. Learn about sensors, automation, and cloud connectivity.
speaker: Engr. Sarah Tan

title: Robotics with Arduino - Advanced Techniques
description: Dive deep into robotics programming with Arduino. Learn about motor control, sensors integration, and autonomous navigation.
speaker: Prof. Michael Chen

title: Wearable Tech and Arduino
description: Create wearable devices using Arduino Nano and LilyPad. From fitness trackers to smart clothing, explore the future of wearable technology.
speaker: Designer Anna Garcia

title: Arduino and Environmental Monitoring
description: Learn how to build environmental monitoring systems using Arduino. Monitor air quality, temperature, humidity, and more for sustainability projects.
speaker: Dr. Patricia Reyes

title: Introduction to Arduino Programming
description: A comprehensive introduction to Arduino programming for absolute beginners. Covered basic syntax, libraries, and first projects.
speaker: Engr. Roberto Santos

title: Arduino and Agriculture Technology
description: Recorded session on using Arduino for smart farming. Learn about automated irrigation, crop monitoring, and precision agriculture.
speaker: Agri-Tech Specialist Carlos Lopez
